test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Raman wants to use a rear-view mirror in his vehicle. Which type of mirror should he pick for it?
solution:
The correct answer is __Convex ____**Mirrors**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**** ****Convex mirror:**

__
 
• The **spherical mirror whose reflecting surface is in upside is called a convex mirror.
 
• It is always from a virtual image of any object.
 
• It is used as a rear-view mirror in the vehicle
 
• It is also from a full-size diminished image of the objects placed at far away distances with a wide range of field of; view.
 
• Due to a wide range of fields of view, we can see the image of the maximum object behind the vehicles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The optical instrument which reflects the light falling on it and makes images of anybody is called a mirror.
 
• A mirror that has a spherical reflecting surface is called a spherical mirror.
 
• A mirror whose reflecting surface is flat is called a plane mirror.
 
• A mirror whose reflecting surface is part of a cylindrical surface is called a cylindrical mirror.
